stem: Which sentence best reveals the dog's view of his relationship with Lewis?

options.label: F
options.text: I stayed with Lewis and the calf, but I walked a few yards behind.

options.label: G
options.text: I was sure Lewis didn't want him around any more than I did.

options.label: H
options.text: Lewis and I were a team; moving close to Lewis was like moving close to me.

options.label: J
options.text: Next, Lewis did something that surprised me.
